Question: A sequence \((a_1, b_1),\) \((a_2, b_2),\) \((a_3, b_3),\) \(\ldots\) of points in the coordinate plane satisfies \[ \begin{aligned} &(a_{n+1}, b_{n+1}) \\ &= \left(\sqrt{3}\,a_n - b_n,\; \sqrt{3}\,b_n + a_n\right) \\ &\quad (n = 1, 2, 3, \ldots) \end{aligned} \] Suppose that \((a_{100}, b_{100}) = (2, 4).\) What is \(a_1 + b_1?\)
